body.value:
TT_103(
    PV_High := 180.0,
    PV_Low := 160.0,
    Scaling_Slope := 11.25,
    Scaling_Offset := -25.0,
    Alarm_Enable := TRUE);
PT_101(
    Alarm_Enable := TRUE);
PIC_101(
    AUTO := TRUE,
    PV := PT_101.PV,
    SP := 800.0,
    MV_MIN := 0.0,
    MV_MAX := 100.0,
    PV_High := 850.0,
    PV_Low := 750.0,
    Inhibit := CascadeInhibit_OR);
FC_202(
    AUTO := TRUE,
    SP := PIC_101.XOUT,
    MV_MIN := 0.0,
    MV_MAX := 100.0,
    Inhibit := PIC_101.PV_Low_Alarm);
FV_202(
    Control_Signal := FC_202.XOUT);
FC_203(
    AUTO := TRUE,
    SP := TIC_104.XOUT,
    MV_MIN := 0.0,
    MV_MAX := 100.0,
    KP := 3.5,
    TR := 0.3,
    Inhibit := TT_103.General_Fault);
SV203Trip_OR := PIC_101.PV_High_Alarm OR TIC_104.PV_High_Alarm;
SV_203(
    Control_Signal := FC_203.XOUT,
    Inhibit := SV203Trip_OR);
CascadeInhibit_OR := TT_103.General_Fault OR PT_101.General_Fault OR SV_203.Alarm OR FV_202.Alarm;
TIC_104(
    AUTO := TRUE,
    PV := TT_103.PV,
    SP := 170.0,
    MV_MIN := 0.0,
    MV_MAX := 100.0,
    KP := 1.2,
    TR := 2.0,
    Inhibit := CascadeInhibit_OR);

(* Outputs published to other sections / HMI. *)
TT_103_Temperature_PV := TT_103.PV;
PT_101_Pressure_PV := PT_101.PV;
TIC_104_RSP_to_FC_203 := TIC_104.XOUT;
PIC_101_RSP_to_FC_202 := PIC_101.XOUT;
FC_203_MV_to_SV_203 := FC_203.XOUT;
FC_202_MV_to_FV_202 := FC_202.XOUT;

AT_102(
    Scaling_Slope := 0.875,
    Scaling_Offset := -3.5,
    Alarm_Enable := TRUE);
AT_107(
    Alarm_Enable := TRUE);
TIT_106(
    Scaling_Slope := 6.25,
    Scaling_Offset := -25.0,
    Alarm_Enable := TRUE);
FV_101(
    Control_Signal := LIC_102.XOUT,
    Open_Limit := 100.0,
    Close_Limit := 0.0,
    Timeout := T#10s,
    Inhibit := AT_107.General_Fault);
PHExtremeTrip_OR := LIC_102.PV_High_Alarm OR LIC_102.PV_Low_Alarm;
LIC_102(
    AUTO := TRUE,
    PV := AT_102.PV,
    SP := 9.25,
    MV_MIN := 10.0,
    MV_MAX := 90.0,
    X0 := FV_101.Feedback_Pos,
    KP := 1.8,
    TR := 0.5,
    TD := 0.1,
    PV_High := 10.5,
    PV_Low := 8.5,
    Deviation_Limit := 1.0,
    Inhibit := PHExtremeTrip_OR);
FV_103(
    Control_Signal := TIC_106.XOUT,
    Open_Limit := 100.0,
    Close_Limit := 0.0,
    Timeout := T#10s);
TIC_106(
    AUTO := TRUE,
    PV := TIT_106.PV,
    SP := 65.0,
    MV_MIN := 0.0,
    MV_MAX := 100.0,
    X0 := FV_103.Feedback_Pos,
    KP := 2.0,
    TR := 0.4,
    TD := 0.05,
    PV_High := 75.0,
    PV_Low := 55.0,
    Inhibit := TIC_106.PV_High_Alarm);
XV_104(
    Control_Signal := LIC_104.XOUT,
    Open_Limit := 100.0,
    Close_Limit := 0.0,
    Timeout := T#10s);
LIC_104(
    AUTO := TRUE,
    SP := 120.0,
    MV_MIN := 0.0,
    MV_MAX := 100.0,
    X0 := XV_104.Feedback_Pos,
    KP := 1.5,
    TR := 1.0,
    TD := 0.2,
    Deviation_Limit := 10.0);

(* Outputs published to other sections / HMI. *)
AT102_pH_PV := AT_102.PV;
AT107_pH_PV := AT_107.PV;
TIT106_Temperature_PV := TIT_106.PV;
LIC102_MV_to_FV101 := LIC_102.XOUT;
TIC106_MV_to_FV103 := TIC_106.XOUT;
LIC104_MV_to_XV104 := LIC_104.XOUT;

TT_801(
    Scaling_Slope := 9.375,
    Scaling_Offset := -37.5,
    Alarm_Enable := TRUE);
TT_802(
    Scaling_Slope := 4.375,
    Scaling_Offset := 32.5,
    Alarm_Enable := TRUE);
PT_801(
    PV_Low := 600.0,
    Alarm_Enable := TRUE);
IR_801(
    PV_High := 5.0,
    Scaling_Slope := 0.625,
    Scaling_Offset := -2.5,
    Alarm_Enable := TRUE);
WT_801(
    Scaling_Slope := 31.25,
    Scaling_Offset := -125.0,
    Alarm_Enable := TRUE);
IR801NotAvailable := NOT IR801_Available;
FanControlInhibit := IR801NotAvailable OR IR_801.High_Alarm OR IR_801.Low_Alarm OR IR_801.General_Fault;
F_801_CTRL(
    AUTO := TRUE,
    PV := IR_801.PV,
    SP := 4.5,
    MV_MIN := 0.0,
    MV_MAX := 100.0,
    KP := 1.8,
    TR := 0.6,
    TD := 0.05,
    Deviation_Limit := 0.2,
    Inhibit := FanControlInhibit);
F_801(
    Speed_SP := F_801_CTRL.XOUT,
    Inhibit := FanControlInhibit);
DriveStop := WT_801.High_Alarm OR WT_801.Low_Alarm;
M_801(
    Inhibit := DriveStop);
SteamFlowInterlock := PT_801.High_Alarm OR PT_801.Low_Alarm OR SC_801.PV_High_Alarm;
SC_801(
    AUTO := TRUE,
    PV := TT_801.PV,
    SP := 115.0,
    MV_MIN := 0.0,
    MV_MAX := 100.0,
    KP := 3.0,
    TR := 0.5,
    TD := 0.1,
    PV_High := 125.0,
    Inhibit := SteamFlowInterlock);
FV_801(
    Control_Signal := SC_801.XOUT,
    Open_Limit := 100.0,
    Close_Limit := 0.0,
    Inhibit := SteamFlowInterlock);
XV802NotOpen := NOT XV802_Open_FB;
HoodTempInhibit := XV802NotOpen OR TT_802.High_Alarm OR TT_802.Low_Alarm;
TC_801(
    AUTO := TRUE,
    PV := TT_802.PV,
    SP := 85.0,
    MV_MIN := 10.0,
    MV_MAX := 90.0,
    KP := 2.5,
    TR := 0.8,
    TD := 0.2,
    PV_High := 95.0,
    Inhibit := HoodTempInhibit);
XV_802(
    Control_Signal := TC_801.XOUT,
    Open_Limit := 90.0,
    Close_Limit := 10.0,
    Inhibit := TC_801.PV_High_Alarm);
M801NotRunning := NOT M_801.FB_Running;
WebTensionInhibit := M801NotRunning OR WT_801.High_Alarm OR WT_801.Low_Alarm;
WT_801_CTRL(
    AUTO := TRUE,
    PV := WT_801.PV,
    SP := 250.0,
    MV_MIN := 0.0,
    MV_MAX := 100.0,
    KP := 4.0,
    TR := 1.0,
    TD := 0.3,
    PV_High := 400.0,
    Inhibit := WebTensionInhibit);

(* Outputs published to other sections / HMI. *)
WT801_DownstreamDriveRoll_Torque_CMD_PCT := WT_801_CTRL.XOUT;
F801_ExhaustFan_Speed_CMD_PCT := F_801.Speed_Out;
FV801_SteamFlowValve_Position_CMD_PCT := FV_801.Valve_Position;
XV802_HotAirDamper_Position_CMD_PCT := XV_802.Valve_Position;

(* Entry point required by OpenPLC Editor v4. The process sections run as parallel program instances under task0; main only provides a scan heartbeat. *)
Heartbeat := NOT Heartbeat;
